Defect Description: Prisma User Directory Count Query Failure
Root Cause: Prisma schema defines User.subscriptionTier as non-nullable String. Using { subscriptionTier: null } in Prisma count filter triggered schema validation exception.
Remediation Applied: Replaced { OR: [{ subscriptionTier: 'FREE' }; { subscriptionTier: null }] } with { subscriptionTier: { notIn: ['PLUS'; 'PREMIUM'] } }.

Defect Description: Super Administrator Legacy Form OTP Rejection
Root Cause: Production admin portal was running older commit (44285d708) without Supabase native TOTP bridge. Submitted OTP to legacy /api/auth/admin-login which checked Postgres local secret instead of Supabase Auth.
Remediation Applied: Transitioned session to preview deployment with native Supabase Auth TOTP bridge. Updated admin.html to pass direct verifyRes access token to /api/auth/admin-supabase-session.

Root Cause: Network TypeError on offline/DNS blips was displayed as generic 'Gateway Unavailable' rather than actionable connectivity advisory.
Remediation Applied: Differentiated network TypeError from HTTP 401/403/503/5xx and surfaced clear connectivity guidelines in checkout return.

Root Cause: getAssuranceSigningSecret fallback generated ephemeral keys in serverless cold starts causing token verification failures.
Remediation Applied: Implemented deterministic preview dev key and strict production 32-char key requirement.

Defect Description: Local Database mfaEnabled Flag Overriding Supabase Factor
Root Cause: Local database mfaEnabled flag could falsely count as MFA verification for designated owner.
Remediation Applied: Enforced Owner Factor Authority: only verified factors directly from Supabase Auth count for owner.

Root Cause: CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_PATHS was declared after CORS middleware in server.ts.
Remediation Applied: Hoisted webhook paths before CORS and body parsing middleware.
